title: ever ELISE|Short Sleeve Ruffled Lace Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant mother-of-the-bride dress offers a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The pleated V-neck and short sleeves create a flattering silhouette, while the ruffled lace adds a delicate touch. Designed for plus-size figures, this formal dress ensures you feel graceful and confident on the big day.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "No Bra" option, with lining.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.


Length: Floor-Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.



Fabric: The garment comprises lace.


Occasion: Mother of the bride dress, Formal evening dress, Mother of the bride dress, Bridal dress, Mature formal dress, Premiere, Banquet.
